lastCompletedStory.title: Pin knip and jscpd as exact devDependencies and de-tokenize the gate invocations

nextStoryContext: knip@6.24.0 and jscpd@5.0.12 are now pinned exact devDependencies (bun.lock updated via `bun add -D` + `bun install`). scripts/check-all.ts's dead-code and dup gates now invoke bare `bunx --bun knip` / `bunx jscpd --config .jscpd.json src scripts` with no inline @version token; bunx resolves the locally installed exact-pinned version first (confirmed via Bun's official bunx docs). Gotcha: adding jscpd as a devDependency makes knip flag it as an 'Unused devDependency' (knip only detects static import/require usage, not CLI-string invocations); fixed with `ignoreDependencies: ["jscpd"]` in knip.json. knip itself is exempt from this check by knip's own special-casing of its own package name. Also updated docs/agent-readiness.md and docs/recovery-runbook.md (both quoted the old `jscpd@5 ...` command literally) to match the de-tokenized invocation, per Doc Maintenance.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed bunx checks for a locally installed package first before falling back to a remote install, and --bun forces Bun's runtime over a Node shebang; matches the de-tokenized gate commands relying on the pinned devDependency being resolved locally.
